# Label File

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Sets the given file's labels to the given label.

## Syntax

~~~~text
labelFile(files: <#Variable (Optional)#>, color: <#Dynamic Enum (WFLabelColorNumber)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
labelFile(files: ShortcutInput, color: Red)
~~~~
